name: L11_wallResolved_CR
note: The SAME L11 mesh recipe (11 layers at ER 1.45, surface level 11) at CONDITION CR: M 0.10, U 34.0 m/s, Re_cref 0.79e6. Per docs/ARGUS_reference_data.md section 9, CR is where BASELINE-VS-MORPHED DELTAS ARE COMPARED AGAINST DSO PREDICTIONS, which is what the v5 matrix is for. Condition-INDEPENDENT files (every mesh dict, fvSchemes, fvSolution, transport and turbulence properties, 0.orig/p) are byte-copied from L11_wallResolved_WT, so the two conditions share ONE mesh recipe and ONE numerics setup and differ only in the freestream. Condition-DEPENDENT files (0.orig U, k, omega, nut) are the real ones from phaseA/CRM_a1p30, whose template alpha is 1.30 deg. controlDict is derived from the WT recipe with magUInf 40.8 -> 34.0, and its liftDir and dragDir are RE-DERIVED FROM THE FREESTREAM rather than inherited, because inheriting them left a 0.803 deg axis lag that verify_recipe.py caught on its first real use. Aref, lRef, CofR and every function object stay byte-identical across the two conditions, which is what makes WT and CR coefficients directly comparable. VERIFIED: |Uinf| 34.000000 equals magUInf 34.0; kInf 1.734e-3 equals 1.5*(34.0*0.001)^2 at the same 0.1 percent intensity as WT; omegaInf 14.25 is 17.10*34.0/40.8 exactly; nut 1.2167e-4 equals k/omega. nut/nu is 8.34 at CR against 10.00 at WT, which is CORRECT: nu is fixed while U changed, i.e. the Reynolds number changed.
